title: PortalNode-01: Lid On, Rack-Mounted, Cables Connected
caption: PortalNode-01 closed, rack-mounted, cables connected
prompt: Create a photorealistic 3D render of a fully assembled PortalNode-01 server, closed with its lid on, installed in a standard 19-inch open-frame server rack. The 4U server chassis is positioned at eye level, centered in the rack, and secured by robust rack-mount rails. The front panel of the chassis is the focal point: it features a precision-perforated mesh grille for ventilation, two sturdy rack-mount handles on either side, and three small, clearly illuminated LED indicators—green for power, blue for GPU activity, and amber for network status. The chassis is matte black brushed aluminum with subtle metallic reflections. From the rear of the chassis, a thick black power cable is neatly routed down the left side of the rack, passing through a vertical cable manager. On the right side, two vibrant green ethernet cables and one blue management cable are bundled and routed downward through a matching cable manager. Directly beneath the PortalNode-01, a 1U rack-mounted UPS unit with a sleek black front and visible ventilation slots occupies the next slot. Above the server, two blank 2U filler panels provide a clean, uninterrupted look. The rack stands on a white raised tile floor in a pristine, modern server room with white walls and subtle reflections. The background is a neutral dark gray gradient, with soft studio lighting highlighting the textures and contours of the hardware. The overall impression is of a professional, production-ready deployment, as seen in high-end vendor product photography. No people, no text overlays, and no extraneous objects—focus on technical accuracy and realism. Landscape aspect ratio (3:2).
